name: HotSchedules (Fourth)
oneLiner: Restaurant employee scheduling and labor management software, now part of Fourth's workforce and inventory platform, with AI labor forecasting and the Fourth iQ manager app.
bestFor: Multi-unit and enterprise restaurant groups that want AI demand forecasting, scheduling, time and attendance, and labor cost control in one system.

updates.text: AI Forecast began factoring in ticketed local events such as concerts and plays near each location, on by default.
Fourth released Fourth iQ 2.0 with the iQ App, giving managers real-time recommendations and alerts across scheduling, HR and inventory on mobile, tablet or web.
Fourth iQ 2.2 added alerts that help restaurant managers prevent inventory shortfalls from the iQ App.

features: AI labor forecasting from sales history, weather and local events
Demand-based schedule building with a schedule score for coverage and cost
Mobile app for shift swaps, availability, messaging and a shift marketplace
Time and attendance with labor law compliance controls
Labor budget tracking and scheduled-vs-actual reporting
Fourth iQ App with manager recommendations and alerts across workforce, HR and inventory
Connects to Fourth's inventory, HR and payroll modules and to restaurant POS systems
notes: HotSchedules merged with Fourth in 2019 and now operates under the Fourth brand; HotSchedules remains the scheduling product name (hotschedules.com help center still live). Use fourth.com as the website. Customer counts conflict across sources (7,000 customers/120,000 locations vs 15,000+ customers), so left out. Vendor case-study percentages (e.g. 75% less scheduling time) left out. Snooze release date not confirmed. 'Pricing based on number of locations and selected modules' from current review not confirmed. No 2026 Fourth announcement found; an iQ 3.0 release was slated for early 2026 but not confirmed.
